sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game is played on a grid, where bubbles of different values are randomly placed. Your goal is to merge bubbles of the same value to create new ones with double values.

         The game features two types of bubbles: numbered bubbles and link bubbles. Numbered bubbles have a specific value, which can range from 2 to 2048. Link bubbles, on the other hand, are used to form links between bubbles. When you merge two bubbles with a link, they are removed from the board and replaced with a new bubble with double the value.

         One of the innovative mechanics in 2048 - Link 'n Merge is the use of links.
